name: GL transaction coding
description: Assign a bank transaction to a general-ledger account, with recent coding history for the same vendor as context.

state.company: Series A B2B SaaS company, accrual basis, US GAAP, fiscal year = calendar year

transaction.card: Corporate card ending 4417, cardholder: Platform Engineering
transaction.memo: Sept usage - prod + staging clusters, reserved instance true-up

state.coding_policy: Production hosting that serves paying customers is cost of revenue (5110). Staging, dev and research compute is R&D (6420). Prepayments over $10,000 covering more than 3 months are capitalized to 1410 and amortized. If a single charge mixes production and non-production usage and the split is not stated, code to the larger component and flag for review.

gl_account.instructions: Which general-ledger account should this transaction be coded to under the company's coding policy?

needs_review.instructions: Should a human accountant review this coding before the books close?

criteria.true: The charge mixes production and non-production usage, includes a prepayment component, or deviates materially from vendor history.
criteria.false: The charge is routine and consistent with prior months.

name: Vendor invoice approval check

invoice.remit_to: ACH, account ending 7731 (changed from ending 2208 on prior invoices)

fraud_risk.instructions: Rate the payment fraud risk of this invoice.

Moderate: one red flag that needs verification
High: multiple red flags; hold payment
Severe: strong indicators of fraud; escalate immediately

name: Contract clause risk scoring
description: Score the risk of a customer contract's liability and indemnity clauses for a sales-ops review queue.

clauses.limitation_of_liability: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) three times (3x) the fees paid or payable by Customer in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, or (b) five million dollars ($5,000,000). 'Excluded Claims' means (i) a party's indemnification obligations, (ii) breach of Section 9 (Confidentiality) or Section 10 (Data Protection), and (iii) a party's gross negligence, fraud or willful misconduct, for which liability shall be uncapped.
clauses.indemnification: Provider shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its affiliates, officers, directors, employees and agents from and against any and all losses, damages, fines, penalties, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to (a) any claim that the Services infringe any intellectual property right of a third party, (b) any breach of Section 10 (Data Protection) by Provider or its subprocessors, including any regulatory fines, notification costs and credit monitoring, and (c) any decision, output or recommendation generated by the Services that is relied upon by Customer in making coverage, claims or eligibility determinations.
clauses.data_protection: Provider shall process Protected Health Information solely as a Business Associate under the attached BAA, shall not use Customer Data to train or improve any model, and shall notify Customer of any Security Incident within twenty-four (24) hours of discovery.
clauses.termination: Customer may terminate for convenience upon ninety (90) days' written notice, and Provider shall refund any prepaid fees for the unused portion of the Term.

state.company_standard_positions: Standard cap: 1x fees paid in prior 12 months. Uncapped only for IP indemnity and fraud. Data breach liability supercapped at 3x fees. No indemnity for customer reliance on model outputs. Breach notification within 72 hours. No termination for convenience in multi-year prepaid deals.

overall_risk.instructions: Rate the overall legal and financial risk of these clauses relative to the company's standard positions.
criteria: High: material exposure; needs GC and CFO approval
Unacceptable: must be renegotiated before signing

worst_clause.instructions: Which clause creates the largest exposure?

revenue_recognition_flag.instructions: Do any clauses create a revenue-recognition concern that finance should review?
